# docs-adr

Use when the user asks for docs adr work.

## Workflow
1. Identify audience, problem, constraints, assumptions and alternatives.
2. Separate facts from decisions.
3. Record context, decision, consequences and rollback.
4. Link to code paths and tests when known.
5. Keep instructions reproducible.

## Verification
State which checks were executed, what passed, and what could not be verified. Favor existing project conventions. Use local resources; do not require network access merely to read this skill.
